title: Converting Documents to Markdown With MarkItDown
description: Learn how to use MarkItDown to convert Excel files, PDFs, and images into clean Markdown that's ready for LLMs and AI workflows.
summary: The MarkItDown library lets you quickly turn PDFs, Office files, images, HTML, and URLs into LLM-ready Markdown. In this video course, you’ll install MarkItDown, use it in Python code to convert and batch-process documents, connect it to AI clients through its MCP server, and see where it falls short compared to tools like Pandoc.
takeaways: In this video course, you’ll install MarkItDown, use it in Python code to convert and batch-process documents, connect it to AI clients through its MCP server, and see where it falls short compared to tools like Pandoc.
By the end of this course, you’ll understand that: Markdown keeps text straightforward while preserving document structure, which makes it a good input format for LLMs .
You can connect MarkItDown’s MCP server to clients like Claude Desktop to expose on-demand conversions to chats.
